title: The Truck with a Room on Its Back
synopsis: Rex, Gus, and Jack meet Dan the donkey and his blue box truck at the new parcel shed; Jack discovers what makes this truck different from Ms. Pam's flatbed.
continuity_state: Before: Pine Park and Little Bridge are complete; Green Gate Farm stores hay; the repaired yellow van and red tractor are both working; Ms. Pam runs Red Door Garage at the west end of Brook Road. No regular local delivery route has yet been established. After: Dan, an adult donkey delivery driver, and his blue enclosed box truck with a rear roll-up door are introduced. His modest covered parcel shed lies on the west side of the farm-road junction near Red Door Garage. Jack draws the box truck beside the earlier flatbed in his blue notebook. Dan has an adult-managed route with deliveries for the garage, park, and farm.
